data.name: Gafaroon
data.gender_notes: Gafaroon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Gafara' meaning 'to purify'. In Islamic history, Prophet Ibrahim (AS) is also known as 'Gafar', as he was the one who purified the Kaaba and all of mankind by rebuilding it and reintroducing the Tawaf (circumambulation) rite. Therefore, this name signifies the removal of impurities, both in the physical and spiritual sense.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a protector or guardian in spiritual matters
data.etymology: Gafaroon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Remover.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gafaroon total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
